messages:
emma_cs: Quick heads-up: Cobalt onboarding showing p95 spikes ~1.8s during batch scoring windows. Renewal in 40 days. Want a concise perf plan (quantize, model swap, route split) before renewal call.
ryan_se: Do we have route breakdown? short UI vs long batch?
emma_cs: UI ~60% (median seq 200), batch scoring ~25% (median seq 1100). KV cache hit ~10%.
veda_ml: Good candidate for split routing. Suggest route UI to redwood-1b-int4 and scoring to redwood-3b-q4_int8 as a cost-latency middle ground. Reserve redwood-7b for rare fallbacks.
chris_pm: Guardrails: start 10% canary to compact route for 48h, require quality delta <1.5% on their 600-sample eval, rollback on error-rate +0.5pp.
am-bot: deploy: canary created -> cobalt_hybrid_2026_03, 10% -> redwood-1b-int4 with fallback to redwood-3b-q4_int8. Dashboard: https://deploys.internal/cobalt_hybrid_2026_03
paul_am: I'll prep a short customer note explaining expected latency gains and opt-out steps.
ryan_se: I'll bench tonight against dedicated-cobalt to estimate p95 improvement and attach traffic snippet.
emma_cs: Action items captured: ryan bench, veda eval, paul customer note. Sync 09:45 tomorrow to review metrics. Thanks.
